Geographies Served Programs "New Wings" -Women Empowerment Program District Tiruvallur Perambalur Madurai Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram State Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Perambalur Madurai Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram States Tamil Nadu The women empowerment program of Uthirathin Uthavigal Charitable Trust focuses on enhancing the socio-economic status of women, particularly those from underprivileged backgrounds. Recognizing the critical role of education in fostering economic independence, the program offers workshops on entrepreneurship and financial literacy, equipping women with essential skills to start and manage their own businesses. Additionally, the trust supports women’s cooperatives in product creation and marketing, fostering community collaboration and providing women with platforms to showcase their talents. Mentorship and networking opportunities further bolster their confidence and capacity to succeed in various fields Educate to Empower Program : Zero to Hero District Bangalore Tiruvallur Perambalur Namakkal Chennai Kanchipuram State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu District Bangalore Tiruvallur Perambalur Namakkal Chennai Kanchipuram States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu The educational program of Uthirathin Uthavigal Charitable Trust focuses on providing comprehensive support to underprivileged students across various regions. Annually, the trust conducts offline and online sessions that reach approximately 72,000 students from 38 districts in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh. The program emphasizes moral education based on the teachings of Thirukkural, benefitting over 120,000 students since 2014. In addition to this foundational education, the trust distributes essential educational materials, such as books and stationery, to orphans and semi-orphans, and organizes tutoring and after-school programs to enhance academic performance. Monthly workshops on study skills and career guidance further empower students, contributing to increased enrollment rates and reduced dropout rates. "Way to Humanity:" Livelihood District Tiruvallur Vellore Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Vellore Chengalpattu Chennai Kanchipuram States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu The livelihood program of Uthirathin Uthavigal Charitable Trust aims to empower unemployed youth by providing them with essential skill-based education and vocational training. Since 2014, the trust has been actively offering courses in various fields, including basic computer applications, electrician training, AC mechanics, beauty therapy, tailoring, and communication skills. With a focus on both urban and rural youth, the program targets individuals who have faced academic challenges, particularly those who have failed 10th or 12th grades. By equipping participants with practical skills relevant to the job market, the trust aims to enhance employability and foster economic independence among youth. Additionally, the program recognizes the unique needs of rural communities by offering training in agriculture and animal husbandry, thereby promoting self-sufficiency and sustainable livelihoods. Tree Plantation Program: "Lets Love our Mother Earth" District Tiruvallur Perambalur Chennai Kanchipuram State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Perambalur Chennai Kanchipuram States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu The tree plantation program of Uthirathin Uthavigal Charitable Trust is dedicated to promoting environmental awareness and sustainability among communities. Through various initiatives, the trust has successfully planted over 10,000 saplings and distributed 5,000 seed balls, engaging local schools and communities in hands-on tree planting events. These activities not only enhance green cover but also instill a sense of responsibility toward environmental conservation in participants, especially the younger generation. By incorporating educational campaigns about the importance of trees and their role in combating climate change, the trust fosters a culture of environmental stewardship. We accommodate special dietary needs and partner with local farms for fresh produce while conducting nutrition workshops to empower healthier choices. We have distributed 300 sewing machines to widows and underprivileged women. Beneficiaries: 20,000+ women Locations: 38 districts in Tamil Nadu, Bangalore, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh Hope Warriors: Support for Differently Abled Persons Since 2014, we have provided skills training, assistive devices, and community awareness programs to support individuals with disabilities, enhancing their quality of life and social inclusion.
